scope: Bidirectional explicit written aliases of the four assessed chat responses, plus 544 uppercase-source whole references to the unchanged canonical translations.

decisions.meaning: Reuse exactly the assessed affirmative, negative, acknowledgement and polite-request meanings from authored_chat_responses.py SHA 786ba051dacdb659199ffe70c60530d23caf7f88af56782c142f32a550cc1447. Case, Ndio/Ndiyo, OK/Okay and straight/curly apostrophe variants preserve the listed conversational function. No new synonym, grammar transformation or source-language assumption is introduced.
decisions.whole_references: Only newly enumerated uppercase source strings gain canonical whole translations. Alternate target spellings are lexical-only, so they cannot introduce conflicting canonical whole-message output. Existing 13,985 references must remain unchanged. Question punctuation, changed clauses and unlisted variants do not inherit whole references.
decisions.readings: Non-Roman targets retain only their previous canonical form and exact assessed reading. No additional sentence reading is created. Native scripts remain the speech input.
decisions.exclusions: All previously omitted Chinese negative/request, Korean please and German Bitte cells remain omitted. No generic case folding is added to the runtime. Complete native boundaries, unique counterparts, protected identifiers and ambiguity checks remain mandatory.
decisions.provenance: Content-bound expansion of an existing assessed project-authored batch. Native tests exposed missing reverse-direction spellings; no reserved conversation text was consulted. The original author and assessment remain unchanged.
decisions.qualification: Require static reference preservation and conflict checks; all native units/readings; canonical, alternate and uppercase forward/reverse replies without translation setup; current Chinese negative cases; cross-platform authored-reference comparison and fresh aggregate coverage. This is author assessment, not independent precision.
